title: Chapter 762 Holy Master Has Fallen Again; Help!
content:
Chapter 762 Holy Master Has Fallen Again; Help!

Chapter 762 Holy Master Has Fallen Again; Help!

Bo Han heaved a sigh of relief.

A powerful tsunami-like curse power surged over.

"Puff!"

Bo Han's heart skipped a beat, his face flushed red as he spat out a mouthful of blood.

He was dispirited at first.

Then, he became extremely deranged. His body would occasionally become bigger and smaller, constantly twisting.

Then, he could not help but roar.

"Roar!"

His voice shook the nine heavens, and his might was unparalleled!

Countless living beings turned into a bloody mist under this roar. It was extremely terrifying.

This roar finally allowed Bo Han to regain some of his consciousness.

His eyes were bloodshot and filled with anger.

In the next moment…

Bo Han soared into the sky like a shooting star, sweeping with endless terrifying power. His speed was extremely fast.

Wherever it passed, it attracted the attention of countless people.

If someone was careful, they would be able to discover the location he was heading to... It was the Buddha Realm!

Hurry up!

Hurry up!

Faster!

The extreme speed produced a dazzling light like the sun.

In just a moment, the Buddha Realm appeared in Bo Han's vision.

Seeing this…

Bo Han's speed didn't slow down at all. On the contrary, he sped up!

Before the enemy arrives, the situation will reach the enemy first!

The terrifying aura caused trees to fall to the ground, mountains to collapse, and the ground to crack!

"Pu Guo went back on his word and cursed me to death. I will use my life as the price to curse Pu Guo!" Bo Han shouted madly."

"Boom!"

As soon as he finished speaking, Bo Han crashed into the Buddha Realm like a comet crashing into the earth, shooting out flames that almost covered half of the Buddha Realm.

A small portion of the Buddha Realm turned into nothingness, and nearly a quarter of the Buddha turned into ashes.

The originally magnificent Buddha Realm became a place of misery and charred black.

At this moment, a sorrowful whimper sounded between heaven and earth.

This sorrowful voice made the Buddha Realm, which had suffered a destructive blow, even more sorrowful.

The death of a Saint was a tragedy for the world!

Inside the Golden Thunderclap Monastery, Bodhi Guo looked at the destroyed Buddha Realm and listened to the chilling voice in his ears. He was completely stunned.

There was only one voice in his heart. It was over, it was over, it was completely over!

In fact, it was just as he had expected.

He was indeed finished.

The enemies of the Buddha Realm took advantage of the chaos to attack when they saw the tragic state of the Buddha Realm.

As for the Sacred Lords, they once again launched a war against the Buddha Realm.

Because they were afraid.

Tyrant, who had previously been his enemy, was cursed to death by the Bodhi Fruit.

Later, Bo Han, who was his friend, was cursed to death by the Bodhi Fruit.

They were worried that the next person to be cursed to death would be them.

The Buddha Realm had fallen into an unprecedented crisis.

....

Tao Qian was completely stunned when he learned about this.

"Tai Ba and Bo Han, these two old brats, died just like that?" he muttered. Isn't that a little too fast?"

"Whoosh!"

At this moment, an armored man appeared in the distance.

He swung his saber at Tao Qian.

The saber aura soared into the sky, its might shaking the heavens.

Tao Qian hurriedly dodged to the side and said helplessly,""I say, now that two Saint Lords have fallen, why are you still chasing after me? Hurry up and join in the fun!"

What responded to him was another sharp saber energy.

....

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

His days were still very relaxed.

Every day, he would accompany Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others for walks and meals. At night, he would work hard and wait quietly for the life in Kailin's stomach to come.

In the blink of an eye, another 100 years passed.

Even though Lin Fan didn't spend any time to cultivate.

However, his cultivation had increased once again and reached the late-stage Sacred Lord realm.

Even if Lin Fan did not use his Curse Arts, he was invincible in this world.

On this day, Lin Fan felt the life force in Kailin's stomach. With nothing to do, he focused on interpersonal relationships.

Then, he used Soul Communication on Ma Zheng.

After all, he was still his subordinate.

After so many years, he did not care at all. It really did not make sense.

....

Water God Palace.

Ma Zhenggang had just returned to his residence after attending a high-level meeting with the elders.

At this moment, a familiar voice suddenly sounded in his mind.

"Ma Zheng!"

It was Master!

Ma Zheng's heart raced as he hurriedly knelt on the ground and spoke in an extremely respectful and excited voice.

"Master!"

"Has anything happened recently?" Lin Fan asked.

"The biggest thing recently is the Demon Race's Holy Lord Tai Ba and the Ocean Holy Lord Bo Han. He has suffered a powerful curse and died one after another. He also stated that the person who cursed him was the Buddha World's Holy Lord, Pu Guo…"

When he said this, he became very careful.

According to Ma Zheng's initial guess, Lin Fan had an extremely powerful curse.

He was the mastermind behind all the curses and murders.

However, after Tai Ba and Bo Han were cursed to death, Ma Zheng started to doubt his previous guess.

It was no wonder that he would be like this.

Yes, Lin Fan was indeed very strong.

However, there was a limit, right?

How could he curse and kill two Holy Masters?

Although he had this suspicion.

However, Ma Zheng's respectful attitude towards Lin Fan didn't change.

"Later on, the Divine World, the Demon World, the Other World, and many other major worlds joined forces to attack the Buddha World and completely shattered it. As for the Buddha Lord, Bodhi Fruit, he escaped…"

When Lin Fan heard that, he was stunned.

So, he had a scapegoat for killing the Holy Lord?

No wonder no one had come looking for him.

Lin Fan let out a weird smile.

His tone was calm as he said,""Alright, I understand."

"How's your cultivation?""

"Thanks to master, my current cultivation level has reached domain lord level 9."Ma Zheng hurriedly said.

Lin Fan nodded," Domain lord level 9, barely not bad. However, it's still a little weak. How about this, I'll help you raise your cultivation.""

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan waved his hand.

A spatial rift suddenly appeared above Ma Zheng's head.

Following that, energy as rich as spring water surged into Ma Zheng's body.

Ma Zheng only felt his entire body warm up. He was so comfortable that he wanted to cry out.

"Pow!"

In just a moment, a soft sound came from Ma Zheng's body.

He, had actually broken through to the universe level!

Even so, the energy in the spatial rift did not disappear and continued to flow into Ma Zheng's body.

It was only when his cultivation reached Universe Level 2 that the crack slowly closed.

In such a short period of time, he actually had such a breakthrough!

Ma Zheng directly prostrated on the ground and shouted excitedly,"Thank you, Master! Thank you, Master!"

Lin Fan said," Continue working hard."

After saying that, he ended the soul communication.

"Yes!" Ma Zheng hurriedly replied.

His attitude towards Lin Fan became even more respectful.

Initially, Ma Zheng was still suspecting if Lin Fan was the mastermind behind the curse.

Now, he believed it again.

And Lin Fan was the mastermind behind the curse. He had cursed Tai Ba and Holy Lord Bo Han to death.

How strong was he?

Thinking of this, Ma Zheng knelt on the ground again and said seriously,"Greetings, Master!"
